prompt:
PURPOSE: Regenerate ONE comic illustration for FIXED holder 360.00 by 502.00 logical pixels, aspect 0.7171:1. PORTRAIT / VERTICAL. Requested output 864x1200. Do NOT resize or redesign the holder. Paint a NEW composition for it, not a framed photo.

SCENE: Rovan sentences Admiral Joseph to be thrown overboard for his arrogance. TECHNICAL: Vertical deck scene at the captured Josephine’s outer rail. Rovan faces Joseph, stern and controlled, navy/crimson coat and familiar face. Joseph is recognisably the same broad clean-shaven man with slicked iron-grey hair, a BRASS MONOCLE over his RIGHT eye and ornate navy/gold uniform. His wrists are bound; two bronze/crimson guards escort him TOWARD the rail. Rovan pronounces the sentence. Joseph looks shaken and stripped of arrogance. This panel shows sentence and escort, NOT the fall or impact. No blood or corpse. Only CRIMSON Veymarch banners with SILVER shield/star are raised on the captured deck; Joseph’s own navy/gold clothing is unchanged, not permission to put an Auric flag behind Rovan. Strong rock-field sky beyond the rail. Keep both faces and speech fully inside the portrait frame.
CAMERA: Re-stage the action vertically, main figure or object stacked with the setting behind, keep head, hands and entire weapon visible.

STYLE: Magneton graphic novel: painted ink, tactile bronze machinery, silver Type C, crimson Veymarch cloth, navy/gold Auric Reach uniforms; atmospheric floating islands. Consistent with supplied scene references, not photorealistic.
